CITY CONTRACT #7155
2020-2021SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT
BETWEEN THE CITY OF CHEYENNE AND SP RADLEY BARR TOYOTA
1.
Parties.Theparties to this Agreement are the City of Cheyenne, a municipal corporation
organized and existing under the laws of the State of Wyoming,2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne,
Wyoming 82001 ("City"), and Spradley Barr Toyota, 2300 Westland Road, Cheyenne,
Wyoming 82001("Spradley Barr").
2.
Purpose of the Agreement.The purpose of this Agreement is to outline the
responsibilities and terms for a Sponsorship Agreement between the parties, and more
specifically, between Spradley Barr and the City.
3.
Term. The term of this Agreement will be from the date of the last signature affixed
until said shows are completed.
Payment. City will provide Spradley Barr an invoice to process payment directly to the
vendor.Spradley Barr agrees to pay the City the amount of Thirty-Five Thousand Dollars
($35,000.00) pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
5.
Events.
As a Platinum Sponsor of the 2020-2021 Broadway Series, in exchange for
Ten Thousand Dollars (S10,000.00)of sponsorship revenue to the City, Spradley Barr will
receive:
Recognition by having a promotional vendor space at the 2020-2021 Broadway Series
shows (i.e., one car outside of Civic Center two hours prior to the show and removed
following the show), print marketing in Broadway Series Brochures, social media, City-
widebanners, out-of-town marketing, andradio announcements.
Shows are:
i）Chicago, the Musical-October 6,2020
i)Charlie and the Chocolate Factory-December6,2020
ii)South Pacific-February 5,2021
iv)Simon&Garfunkel Story-(Offersent-February2021)
v)Fiddler on the Roof-(Offer sent-May 2020)

B.As the Family Film Series Presenting Sponsor, in exchange for Five
Thousand Dollars (S5,000.00) as sponsorship revenue to the City, Spradley Barr will
receive:
Recognition by having a promotional vendor space at the 2020-2021 Family Film Series
(ie., one car outside of Civic Center, or booth space in the lobby two hours prior to the
show and removed following the show), print marketing, social media, and radio
announcements.
Shows will include two summer films, a Halloween film, a Christmas film, and a Spring
Break film.This film series will begin Summer 2020.

D. As an Art Access Sponsor, in exchange for Five Thousand Dollars (S5,000.00)
as sponsorship revenue to the City, Spradley Barr will receive:
Recognition as a Civic Center Art Access Sponsor in the Lobby, acknowledgement at

The Art Access Program provides free ticket vouchers to youth, families, seniors and non-profits
tohave access to Cheyenne Civic Center shows andevents.
6.General Provisions.
A. Amendments. Any changes, modifications, revisions or amendments to this
Agreement, which are mutually agreed upon by the parties, will be incorporated by writing.
B. Applicable Law. The construction, interpretation and enforcement of this
Agreement is govermed by the laws of the State of Wyoming. The courts of the State of
Wyoming shall have jurisdiction over this Agreement and parties, and the venue shall be in the
First Judicial District, Laramie County, Wyoming.
